errors.APPROVAL_REQUIRED: This change needs an approver. Submit a request instead.
errors.BAD_REQUEST: The request is not valid. Check the values and try again.
errors.BULK_NOT_ALLOWED: This change cannot be made in bulk. Change each item on its own.
errors.BULK_TOO_LARGE: Too many items for one bulk change. Narrow the selection.
errors.CONFLICT: This conflicts with the current state. Reload and try again.
errors.CONTENT_SIGNING_UNAVAILABLE: Content signing is not available right now.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: This idempotency key was already used for a different request.
errors.INTEGRATION_AUTH_FAILED: The service refused the API token. Check it, or create a new one, and test again.
errors.INTEGRATION_CREDENTIALS_UNREADABL: The saved API token of this connection cannot be read. Enter it again.
errors.INTEGRATION_EMAIL_RELAY_POLICY: This mail server does not meet the service rules: use port 465, 587 or 2525 with a username, a password and TLS. Sending is stopped until you edit it and test again.
errors.INTEGRATION_FORBIDDEN: The token works but lacks a permission this needs. Grant it on the service and test again.
errors.INTEGRATION_NOT_FOUND: The service did not find what this connection points at. Check the address and project.
errors.INTEGRATION_NO_CREDENTIALS: This connection has no API token. Add one to use it.
errors.INTEGRATION_RATE_LIMITED: The service is limiting requests. Wait a minute and test again.
errors.INTEGRATION_TEST_FAILED: The connection test failed. Check the settings and test again.
errors.INTEGRATION_UNREACHABLE: The service could not be reached. Check the address and that it is online.
errors.INTEGRATION_UPSTREAM_ERROR: The service answered with an error. Try again later.
errors.INTEGRATION_URL_BLOCKED: This address is not allowed by the outbound network policy.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something failed on the server. Try again; if it keeps failing, contact support with the reference.
errors.INVALID_FILTER: The filter is not valid. Check the fields and values.
errors.INVALID_INCLUDE: The include parameter is not valid.
errors.MFA_ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED: Your organization requires two-factor authentication. Sign in again to set it up.
errors.MODULE_NOT_ENABLED: This module is not enabled for your organization.
errors.NOT_FOUND: Not found. It may have been deleted, or you may not have access to it.
errors.OPERATION_RUNNING: You already have an operation running. Wait for it to finish.
errors.QUERY_TIMEOUT: This took too long to answer. Narrow the filter or search and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.REAUTH_REQUIRED: For your security, sign in again to set up two-factor authentication.
errors.RELEASE_FEED_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than the release feed limit.
errors.SELECTION_CHANGED: The selection changed since you confirmed it. Review the new count and confirm again.
errors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The service is not available right now. Try again in a minute.
errors.TICKET_BELOW_THRESHOLD: This finding is below the ticketing threshold.
errors.TICKET_EGRESS_REFUSED: The organization's data policy does not allow sending this to the ticketing service.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session ended. Sign in to continue.
errors.UPSTREAM_ERROR: A service this depends on did not answer correctly. Try again later.
errors.generic: Could not complete this. Try again.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
